content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Condensation on my mirror forms letters. Yesterday it spelled my name.
I can’t verify intent in condensation. Were the letters photographed, and was the room lighting constant?
No photo, just saw it after a shower.
Photos from a fixed angle across several days would allow comparison. Steam patterns often repeat along previous wipe marks.
So previous wipes could guide the shapes.
Yes. A cleaned mirror and a note of where and when patterns appear can help distinguish residue effects from new formations.
I’ll keep the angle steady and take shots next time.
